adjustments: Week of 21 Sep is a deload: every working weight x0.9 rounded down to the step, assistance +2 kg, one working set fewer per exercise, RIR +1, sessions 12 min shorter.
Narrow-grip pull-down regresses: 2 Oct 47.5 x 10/9/8, 7 Oct 46.25 x 10/9/9 (note: elbow sore), 12 Oct 46.25 x 9/8/8.

Session notes moved to an A day: "Left shoulder a bit tight on bench." Fri 2 Oct -> Wed 30 Sep; "Gym crowded, did push-ups on the floor." Fri 3 Jul -> Wed 1 Jul (both name A exercises but sat on B days).

rules.workingSets: Every set that is not a warm-up. Drop and failure sets count as full sets for volume and muscle sets; drop sets never set records.
rules.e1rm: Epley w x (1 + r/30), only for lifts programmed at 10 reps or fewer (back-squat, db-bench-press, machine-shoulder-press, deadlift, machine-row), only from sets of 10 reps or fewer. Always labelled estimated.
rules.pr: At most one record per lift per session, first match wins: Heaviest weight (or Least assistance, or First added load) > Rep record (more reps in one set at a weight or assistance already lifted) > Estimated 1RM (+0.5 kg or more, e1RM lifts only). A lift's first session is its baseline, not a record. Deload sessions never set records.
rules.verdict: Needs 4 non-deload sessions of the lift, else "too new". slipping: the last 2 sessions are both below the best top set of the 4 sessions before them (lower weight, or same weight and fewer reps). stalled: no record in the last 4 non-deload sessions. moving: otherwise. Deload sessions are skipped, gaps never count.
rules.muscleSets: 1 per primary muscle, 0.5 per secondary, working sets only, 12 muscles; forearms and traps are counted but only shown in drill-downs.
rules.week: Calendar week Monday 00:00 to Sunday, by session start. Volume comparisons use 2-week windows (one ABA + one BAB week).
